locations.title: Forest Haven
locations.description: Forest Haven is an island enclosed in a hollowed-out tree trunk. It is home to the great Deku Tree and the Koroks, as well as magical spring water.

locations.title: Forsaken Fortress
locations.description: Tetra's ship's cannon shoots Link over to the Forsaken Fortress to rescue Aryll.

locations.title: Ice Ring Isle
locations.description: Ice Ring Isle is a mini dungeon surrounded by an icy aura. To enter, Link has to shoot a Fire Arrow at the center rock head, then navigate across an icy path to the mouth of the structure. After recovering the Iron Boots, Link can use them to access a lower floor and defeat the enemies there for an Orange Rupee.

locations.title: Rock Spire Isle
locations.description: Rock Spire Isle itself is a series of spires, with boulders on top, that you need to blow up one by one, then leap across.

locations.title: Windfall Island
locations.description: Windfall Island is the central town and store hub. Reminiscent of Kakariko Village, it's recognizable even from far away by its iconic windmill.

locations.title: Forbidden Woods
locations.description: Get the Boomerang, defeat the Boss and get Farore's Pearl.

locations.title: Ganon's Castle
locations.description: Defeat the four Bosses, defeat Puppet Ganon, get the Light Arrows, defeat the final Boss.

locations.description: Medli will give you this bottle after you help her fly to the entrance of the Dragon Roost Cavern.

locations.title: Empty Bottle #2
locations.description: Enter the submarine near Bomb Isle and defeat all the Bokoblin enemies inside.

locations.title: Empty Bottle #3
locations.description: Buy the bottle for 500 Rupees in Beedle's Special Shop Ship near Rock Spire Isle.

locations.title: Empty Bottle #4
locations.description: Complete the Follow the Thief mini-quest on Windfall Island. It must be night time. Confront Mila about her planned theft and answer all questions with the default answer to get the last Bottle.

locations.title: Tingle Bottle
locations.description:
The Tingle Bottle is an item added to The Legend of Zelda: Wind Waker HD for the Wii U. You get it from Tingle when you free him from the jail on Windfall Island.

This item unlocks the option to write a message and throw it into the ocean. This is how you use Wind Waker's Miiverse feature. You can also find a Tingle Bottle lying on the shore containing a Miiverse post.

locations.title: Piece of Heart 5
locations.description:
**Location:** Spectacle Island Cannon Minigame

Play the Cannon Minigame and destroy all targets (using 10 shots or fewer).

locations.title: Piece of Heart 1
locations.description:
**Location:** Found in a cell below the treasure chest with the dungeon map. 

The switch to open the cell door is hidden behind the barrels.

locations.title: Piece of Heart 10
locations.description:
Location: Small island near the Windfall Island docks

After activating the lighthouse, open the treasure chest on the small island near the docks. Use the Hookshot or Deku Leaf to get on top.

locations.title: Piece of Heart 11
locations.description:
Location: Maggie's Letter Quest - Windfall Island Auction House, Cafe Bar

Receive the letter from [Maggie](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-wind-waker/maps/great-sea?locationIds=450252) after she returns to Windfall as a rich person. Deliver her letter to the [Mailbox](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-wind-waker/maps/great-sea?locationIds=448984). Find Ilari, the Rito Postman, inside the Auction House. Then talk to him in the Cafe Bar. Give Moe's Letter to Maggie.

locations.title: Piece of Heart 12
locations.description:
**Location:** Outset Island Cafe Bar (End of Quest)

Complete the Picto Box quest to make [Anton](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-wind-waker/maps/great-sea?locationIds=448991) and [Linda](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-wind-waker/maps/great-sea?locationIds=448997) fall in love. Take a picture of Linda and show it to Anton. Go to the Cafe Bar the next day to get the Piece of Heart from them.

locations.title: Piece of Heart 13
locations.description:
Location: Zunari's Trading Quest - complete the quest for [Magic Armor](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-wind-waker/maps/great-sea?locationIds=447306) to get the Exotic Flower.'


* Travel to Bomb Isle to trade for a Sickle Moon Flag.
* Back to Greatfish Isle to trade the flagpole for a Fountain Idol.
* Mother & Child Isles (remember to sail -- you cannot warp to Child Isle) for a Big Sale Flag.
* Go to Bomb Isle. Get the Hero's Flag for 75 Rupees.
* Greatfish Isle. You get a Postman Statue for 100 Rupees.
* Mother & Child Isles. A 200 Rupees gets you the Shop Guru Statue.
* Greatfish Isle. Show the golden statue to the Goron.

locations.title: Piece of Heart 14
locations.description:
**Location:** Windfall Island

Items to decorate Windfall Island can be obtained as part of Zunari's Trading Quest. These items can all be used to beautify the town. Just place an item in all of the 14 open sockets around the island. Talk to Sam, the man sitting on the bench, to get a Piece of Heart.

locations.title: Piece of Heart 15
locations.description:
**Location:** Inside the dome on Pawprint Isle

Crawl into the shell-like dome and open the treasure chest.

locations.title: Piece of Heart 16
locations.description:
**Location:** Inside sunken Treasure Chest

Use [Treasure Chart 30](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-wind-waker/maps/great-sea?locationIds=454704) to find the sunken chest.

locations.title: Piece of Heart 19
locations.description:
**Location:** Flight Control Platform Gliding Challenge

Get the expanded magic meter by defeating the Big Octo at Two-Eye Reef, then float to the goal in the Deku gliding challenge.

locations.title: Piece of Heart 20
locations.description:
Location: Beedle's Special Shop Boat

Buy the Heart Piece from Beedle's Special Shop Boat for 950 Rupees.

locations.title: Piece of Heart 21
locations.description:
**Location:** In the ocean, near Rock Spire Isle.

Sink the two golden gunboats and use the Grappling Hook to retrieve the sunken chests where the boats sank. One will contain the heart.

locations.title: Piece of Heart 22
locations.description:
**Location:** Inside a sunken Treasure Chest

 Use [Treasure Chart 2](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-wind-waker/maps/great-sea?locationIds=454587) to find the sunken chest location.

locations.title: Piece of Heart 23
locations.description:
**Location:** In the ocean near of Tingle Island

Look for the seagulls above the water and find and defeat the Big Octo in this sector.

locations.title: Piece of Heart 24
locations.description:
**Location:** Inside sunken chest, marked on [Treasure Chart 38](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-wind-waker/maps/great-sea?locationIds=454710)

**Contents:** Piece of Heart

locations.title: Piece of Heart 25
locations.description:
Location: In the small opening in the rock at Greatfish Isle

Change the wind direction to the northwest, then float to the small opening in the rock wall (start from the rock with the Korok tree spirit).

locations.title: Piece of Heart 26
locations.description:
**Location:** Inside the Submarine

Enter the submarine and defeat all the Moblins.

locations.title: Piece of Heart 27
locations.description:
**Location:** Inside sunken Treasure Chest

Use [Treasure Chart 5](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-wind-waker/maps/great-sea?locationIds=454591) to track down the sunken chest.

locations.title: Piece of Heart 28
locations.description:
**Location:** Inside the fiery treasure chest on the dirt patch. Activate the crystal switch on top of the spire to lower the flames.

**Contents:** Piece of Heart health upgrade

locations.title: Piece of Heart 29
locations.description:
Location: Inside a Treasure Chest on the lookout platform

Destroy all the cannons on the lookout platform to make the chest appear.

locations.title: Piece of Heart 31
locations.description:
**Location:** Inside Bomb Island Cave

Blow up the large rock, enter the cave, and use the Magtails to activate the switches.

locations.title: Piece of Heart 30
locations.description:
**Location:** Inside a sunken Treasure Chest southwest of the isle

Use [Treasure Chart 20](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-wind-waker/maps/great-sea?locationIds=454603) to find the sunken chest.

locations.title: Piece of Heart 32
locations.description:
**Location:** Use [Treasure Chart 23](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-wind-waker/maps/great-sea?locationIds=454619) to find the sunken chest

**Contents:** Piece of Heart health upgrade

_Note: the location of this chest is slightly different for each playthrough._

locations.title: Piece of Heart 33
locations.description:
**Location:** Inside sunken Treasure Chest southeast of the island

Use [Treasure Chart 4](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-wind-waker/maps/great-sea?locationIds=447360) to find the sunken chest.

locations.title: Piece of Heart 35
locations.description:
Location: Depends on where you complete the Forest Haven Korok Tree Quest

Go to Forest Haven and scoop up some forest spring water with your Bottle. The contents of one bottle can heal (multiple) withering plants, but its healing powers only last 20 minutes (30 minutes in Wind Waker HD)

Travel to these islands:

* A-5: Needle Rock Isle
* B-1: Star Island
* B-2: Mother & Child Isles
* B-4: Greatfish Isle
* C-6: Shark Island
* E-3: Eastern Fairy Island
* E-5: Link's Oasis
* G-6: Cliff Plateau Isles

locations.title: Piece of Heart 34
locations.description:
**Location:** Inside the nearest Mailbox after completing the Forbidden Woods

Check the mailbox after you've come back from the Forbidden Woods. Komali's father's letter will have a heart attached.

locations.title: Piece of Heart 36
locations.description:
**Location:** In sunken Treasure Chest

Use [Treasure Chart 31](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-wind-waker/maps/great-sea?locationIds=447351) to locate the chest.

locations.title: Piece of Heart 39 - HD Version
locations.description:
Location: Inside the sunken Treasure Chest - HD Version Only

Note: Find the location with the help of [Treasure Chart 46](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-wind-waker/maps/great-sea?locationIds=454729). This location only applies to the Wii U/HD edition of the game. 

 Note for the Wii U Version: use Treasure Chart 46 to find the sunken chest (replaces Triforce Shard location).

locations.title: Piece of Heart 40
locations.description:
Location: On top of the Headstone Island spire

Stand on the beach and put a Hyoi Pear on your head to call a seagull. Fly to the very top of the rock spire in the center.

locations.title: Piece of Heart 42
locations.description:
**Location:** Inside a sunken Treasure Chest south of the smaller island.

Use [Treasure Chart 15](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-wind-waker/maps/great-sea?locationIds=454598) to find and raise this sunken chest.

locations.title: Piece of Heart 3
locations.description:
**Location:** Inside a sunken Treasure Chest

Use [Treasure Chart 11](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-wind-waker/maps/great-sea?locationIds=454596)  to track down the sunken chest.

locations.title: Piece of Heart 43
locations.description:
**Location:** Inside the Submarine near the Five Star Isles

Find and enter the submarine and defeat the Bokoblins and Keese bats inside. Climb up the ladder and a torch will light up, revealing a treasure chest.

locations.title: Piece of Heart 41
locations.description:
Location: On top of the larger Angular Isle.

Push the blocks and find the chest at the top of the isle.

locations.title: Piece of Heart 44
locations.description:
**Location:** In a sunken Treasure Chest

Use [Treasure Chart 33](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-wind-waker/maps/great-sea?locationIds=447352) to track down the location.

locations.title: Piece of Heart 4
locations.description:
**Location:** Defeat Big Octo near Seven-Star Isles

Look for the flock of seagulls above the water. Follow them to make Big Octo appear, then use your Boomerang or cannon to shoot out the creature's eyes. After you defeat it, use the Grappling Hook on the area where it sank.

locations.title: Piece of Heart 6
locations.description:
**Location:** Battlesquid in Salvatore's House

Talk to Salvatore to play Battesquid. Win the Battlesquid Game by sinking all three squids.

locations.title: Piece of Heart 7
locations.description:
**Location:** Start the Cabana Quest in the School

Find all four Killer Bees kids and complete the [Killer Bees Hide-and-Seek](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-wind-waker/maps/great-sea?locationIds=450268) quest.

locations.title: Piece of Heart 8
locations.description:
**Location:** Hall of Wealth Auction House

Participate in the nightly auctions in the rich man's house. A Piece of Heart will appear as a prize after you've won a few auctions.

locations.title: Piece of Heart 9
locations.description:
**Location:** Windmill on Windfall Island

Activate the lighthouse windmill by changing the wind direction to north, stepping on the switch at the top of the ladder (in the rear), and shooting an arrow at the central torch. Talk to the man with the hat on the wooden windmill walkway (exit through the door on the second floor from the Battlesquid house).

locations.title: Piece of Heart 2
locations.description:
**Location:** Blow up the boulders with bombs to reveal a hidden cave. 

Defeat all Magtails, Bokoblins, and Moblins.

locations.title: Piece of Heart 17
locations.description:
**Location:** Dragon Roost Mail Center

Beat the mail sorting mini-game by scoring 25 to make Baito, the part-time worker arrive in the mail station. Talk to him and beat the 25 again to get the [Note to Mother](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-wind-waker/maps/great-sea?locationIds=458355). Drop it into a mailbox, then wait for a reply containing the heart.

locations.title: Piece of Heart 18
locations.description:
**Location:** Hoskit, inside the Mail Station on Dragon Roost Island

Give 20 Golden Feathers to Hoskit, the Rito Guard and he will give Link an Orange Rupee and later send this Piece of Heart by mail.

locations.title: Piece of Heart 37
locations.description:
Location: Outset Island Mudpit

Once you have the Power Bracelets, return to the island and carry the [Black Pig](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-wind-waker/maps/great-sea?locationIds=448967) to the muddy spot across the bridge. Use bait and it will dig up the heart.

locations.title: Piece of Heart 38
locations.description:
**Location:** Orca's Hut on Outset Island

Compete against Orca in his sword challenge and hit him 500 times.

locations.title: Piece of Heart 39 - GameCube Version
locations.description:
**Location:** Savage Labyrinth on Outset Island

Battle your way through the Savage Labyrinth and reach the 50th floor. (GameCube Version only)

locations.title: Wandering Merchant
locations.description:
* **Set:** Hall G: The Great Sea
* **Missable:** No

Find this Goron Trader on Greatfish Isle, as well as on Bomb Island, and Child Isle. Only one picture is needed for the triple figurine. 

This Goron Trader figures in Zunari's Trade Quest. Receive a Piece of Heart from him for completing the quest.

locations.title: Aryll
locations.description:
* **Set:** Hall E: Outset Island
* **Missable:** No

Aryll, Link's sister figures prominently in the overall main quest. She is also available as a Nintendo Gallery Figurine -- but only by snapping a picture of Link's Grandmother.

locations.title: Sturgeon
locations.description:
* **Set:** Hall E: Outset Island
* **Missable:** No

Talk to the old man by targeting him. You can visit him on the second floor by climbing the ladder to get tutorial tips.

locations.title: Orca
locations.description:
* **Set:** Hall E: Outset Island
* **Missable:** No

Old master of the sword. Inside his house in the middle of town (first floor). Train with Orca to receive the Hero's Sword and learn basic attack moves.

locations.title: Abe
locations.description:
* **Set:** Hall E: Outset Island
* **Missable:** No

Bearded man in green. Wandering around during the day, in his home at night.

locations.title: Zill
locations.description:
* **Set:** Hall E: Outset Island
* **Missable:** No

Snot-nosed kid, wandering about during the day, inside his house at night.

locations.title: Mesa
locations.description:
* **Set:** Hall E: Outset Island
* **Missable:** No

Guy in orange, cuts his grass during the day. Find him in his house at night. Mesa teaches Link about cutting grass and can be captured for the Nintendo Gallery.

locations.title: Grandma
locations.description:
* **Set:** Hall E: Outset Island
* **Missable:** No

Link's grandmother, found inside Link's home. She not only provides links with equipment and advice, but can also be captured as a Nintendo Gallery Figuring. Take a photo and [Aryll](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-wind-waker/maps/great-sea?locationIds=448942) will unlock at the same time.

locations.title: Sue-Belle
locations.description:
* **Set:** Hall E: Outset Island
* **Missable:** No

The woman in the pink dress carries a pot on her head during the day. Find her in Sturgeon's house at night. Note that if you smash her pot, you'll have to pay 10 Rupees

locations.title: Beedle
locations.description:
* **Set:** Hall G: The Great Sea
* **Missable:** No

Floating boat shop owner. Outset Island, Forest Haven, and other locations.

locations.title: Rose
locations.description:
* **Set:** Hall E: Outset Island
* **Missable:** No

Rose is the owner of the pigs roaming around the island. She's married to Abe and has two kids, Joel and the snot-nosed Zill.

Return the three piglets roaming the island to her to receive 3 x 20 Rupees.

locations.title: Joel
locations.description:
* **Set:** Hall E: Outset Island
* **Missable:** No

Joel is Zill's brother, and the older son of Abe and Rose. You can find the little boy with his stick near the stone bridge during the day, in his house at night.

locations.title: Potova & Joanna
locations.description:
* **Set:** Hall F: Windfall Island
* **Missable:** No

Treated as a pair, Potova & Joanna are the self-proclaimed cute little girls. They're always together, either in the school or by the beach.

locations.title: Dampa
locations.description:
* **Set:** Hall F: Windfall Island
* **Missable:** No

Dampa tells you about his pet pigs. He is outside the Bomb Shop during the day and inside the Cafe at night.

locations.title: Maggie's Father
locations.description:
* **Set:** Hall F: Windfall Island
* **Missable:** No

Maggie's Father will ask you to rescue his daughter, Maggie, when you first meet him sitting at the tree at the beginning of game. He later becomes rich and resides on the second floor of the rich man's Mansion.

locations.title: Kane
locations.description:
* **Set:** Hall F: Windfall Island
* **Missable:** No

Kane, the sailor, will reward Link for decorating the town. He's the big guy, wearing a green and blue shirt. By the town gate during the day and inside the cafe at night.

* 50 Rupees: Place Postman Statue on top of the gate
* 50 Rupees: Place Shop Guru on top of the gate
* 20 Rupees: Place Idols on top of the six pedestals
* 20 Rupees: Place flags on top of the six pedestals

locations.title: Candy
locations.description:
* **Set:** Hall F: Windfall Island
* **Missable:** No

Candy, the sailor, will reprimand Link for asking him for a sail.

locations.title: Anton
locations.description:
* **Set:** Hall F: Windfall Island
* **Missable:** No

Anton, wearing a striped shirt, will walk around town and is found in many locations

locations.title: Tott
locations.description:
* **Set:** Hall F: Windfall Island
* **Missable:** No

Tott, the dancer, will teach Link the Song of Passing once he has the Wind Waker.

locations.title: Linda
locations.description:
* **Set:** Hall F: Windfall Island
* **Missable:** No

Linda is the young woman in orange, near the windmill. She'll be inside the cafe after concluding her photo quest.

Take a Pictograph of Linda and show it to Anton to have the two fall in love. 

Reward:
* Piece of Heart

locations.title: Killer Bees
locations.description:
* **Set:** Hall F: Windfall Island
* **Missable:** No

Four kids, hanging out near the school. Only a photo of one of them is needed for the quadruple figurine. This group of kids is made up of Ivan, Jin, Jun-Roberto, and Jan.

locations.title: Old Man Ho Ho
locations.description:
* **Set:** Hall G: The Great Sea
* **Missable:** No

Old Man Ho Ho appears in multiple locations and provides hints on surrounding areas.

locations.title: Ankle
locations.description:
* **Set:** Hall G: The Great Sea
* **Missable:** No

Tingle in pink clothes. Found on top of the Tingle Island tower.

locations.title: David Jr.
locations.description:
* **Set:** Hall G: The Great Sea
* **Missable:** No

Tingle in white clothes. Found on the Tingle Island tower.

locations.title: Fairy
locations.description:
* **Set:** Hall G: The Great Sea
* **Missable:** No

Find these tiny fairies inside pots or at any of the Fairy Wells.

locations.title: Lenzo
locations.description:
* **Set:** Hall F: Windfall Island
* **Missable:** No

Bearded Picto Shop owner, inside his atelier all day and night. Go to the second floor or sneak in through balcony to get a good shot.

locations.title: Fairy Queen
locations.description:
* **Set:** Hall G: The Great Sea
* **Missable:** No

The Fairy Queen Pictograph cannot be taken at the Queen's location. You have to buy this Legendary Pictograph from Lenzo during a night with a Waning Crescent moon.

locations.title: Fishman
locations.description:
* **Set:** Hall G: The Great Sea
* **Missable:** No

Unlocked when taking a photo of [Tetra](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-wind-waker/maps/great-sea?locationIds=450215).

This talking fish that can be found near every island. Snap a picture from far away when he's jumping out of the water.

locations.title: Tetra
locations.description:
* **Missable:** Yes
* **Set:** Hall G: The Great Sea

Unlocked when taking a photo of [Tetra](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-wind-waker/maps/great-sea?locationIds=450215). Also unlocks the entire Pirate Posse.

Snap her picture of Tetra she follows you into Hyrule Castle. If missed, you can get her by starting the Second Quest and take a picture of her on the beach on Outset Island.

locations.title: Senza
locations.description:
* **Set:** Hall G: The Great Sea
* **Missable:** Yes

Unlocked when taking a photo of [Tetra](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-wind-waker/maps/great-sea?locationIds=450215).

locations.title: Zuko
locations.description:
* **Set:** Hall G: The Great Sea
* **Missable:** Yes

Unlocked when taking a photo of [Tetra](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-wind-waker/maps/great-sea?locationIds=450215).

locations.title: Gonzo
locations.description:
* **Set:** Hall G: The Great Sea
* **Missable:** Yes

Unlocked when taking a photo of [Tetra](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-wind-waker/maps/great-sea?locationIds=450215).

locations.title: Mako
locations.description:
* **Set:** Hall G: The Great Sea
* **Missable:** Yes

Unlocked when taking a photo of [Tetra](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-wind-waker/maps/great-sea?locationIds=450215).

locations.title: Niko
locations.description:
* **Set:** Hall G: The Great Sea
* **Missable:** Yes

Unlocked when taking a photo of [Tetra](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-wind-waker/maps/great-sea?locationIds=450215).

locations.title: Nudge
locations.description:
* **Set:** Hall G: The Great Sea
* **Missable:** Yes

Unlocked when taking a photo of [Tetra](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-wind-waker/maps/great-sea?locationIds=450215).

locations.title: Great Fairy
locations.description:
* **Set:** Hall G: The Great Sea
* **Missable:** No

Buy the Legendary Pictograph from Lenzo (Available when the moon is in its Waning Gibbous phase).

locations.title: King of Hyrule
locations.description:
* **Set:** Hall G: The Great Sea
* **Missable:** No

Buy the Legendary Pictograph from Lenzo (available when the moon is in its Waxing Gibbous phase).

locations.title: Knuckle
locations.description:
* **Set:** Hall G: The Great Sea
* **Missable:** This statue is not required to complete the Gallery

Appears on Tingle Island after solving his GBA Tingle Tuner challenge on Outset Island. Knuckle is missable in the GameCube version. Make sure to take the photo before collecting all Tingle Status (he becomes available after completing the Tingle Tuner event). In the HD version, he will remain on Tingle Island.

locations.title: Link and the King of Red Lions
locations.description:
* **Set:** Hall G: The Great Sea
* **Missable:** Yes (If previous figurines are missed)

Bonus figurine. Awarded once you collect all figurines (except Knuckle).

locations.title: Loot
locations.description:
* **Set:** Hall G: The Great Sea
* **Missable:** No

Found at the Boating Course island during the day and in the Windfall cafe at night.

locations.title: Princess Zelda
locations.description:
* **Set:** Hall G: The Great Sea
* **Missable:** No

Bundled with [King of Hyrule](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-wind-waker/maps/great-sea?locationIds=450223). No photo necessary.

locations.title: Salvage Corp
locations.description:
* **Set:** Hall G: The Great Sea
* **Missable:** No

Look for this diving crew searching for treasures near several islands. You're likely to encounter them first in this location.

locations.title: Salvatore
locations.description:
* **Set:** Hall G: The Great Sea
* **Missable:** No

Salvatore is the challenge attraction owner. He is found in the Windfall Island windmill building and on Spectacle Island.

locations.title: Tingle
locations.description:
* **Set:** Hall G: The Great Sea
* **Missable:** No

Once rescued from the [Windfall Island Jail](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-wind-waker/maps/great-sea?locationIds=448995), the green fairy is found on the Tingle Island tower.

locations.title: Cannon
locations.description:
* **Set:** Hall F: Windfall Island
* **Missable:** No

The owner of the Bomb Shop is found inside the building at the edge of town.

locations.title: Zunari
locations.description:
* **Set:** Hall F: Windfall Island
* **Missable:** No

Owner of the local shop.

locations.title: Doc Bandam
locations.description:
* **Set:** Hall F: Windfall Island
* **Missable:** No

Doc Bandam is the Potion Shop owner. He's inside the Chu Jelly Juice shop at all times.

locations.title: Garrickson
locations.description:
* **Set:** Hall F: Windfall Island
* **Missable:** No

Dressed in red overalls, Garrickson is the love-stricken mustachioed man wo walks to the mailbox every day.

locations.title: Kamo
locations.description:
* **Set:** Hall F: Windfall Island
* **Missable:** No

Depressed young man. Sitting on the steps during the day, gazing at the stars on the town wall at night.

Has [Treasure Chart 31](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-wind-waker/maps/great-sea?locationIds=447351).

locations.title: Kreeb
locations.description:
* **Set:** Hall F: Windfall Island
* **Missable:** No

Man with yellow hat, on the wooden windmill walkway (exit the second floor above Salvatore's Battlesquid challenge).

locations.title: Maggie
locations.description:
* **Set:** Hall F: Windfall Island
* **Missable:** No

Rich little girl (once poor), on the second floor of the rich man's house (above the auction)

locations.title: Mila
locations.description:
* **Set:** Hall F: Windfall Island
* **Missable:** No

This poor little girl (once rich, before her fortune's were reversed), is found near the gate and Juice Shop, and later near Zunari's stand.

locations.title: Mila's Father
locations.description:
* **Set:** Hall F: Windfall Island
* **Missable:** No

Rich man, first encountered in his house on the second floor. He later becomes poor and stands by the tree near the Bomb Shop where it's easy to take his picture.

locations.title: Minenco
locations.description:
* **Set:** Hall F: Windfall Island
* **Missable:** No

Minenco is th older lady in orange, by the Juice Shop.

locations.title: Missy
locations.description:
* **Set:** Hall F: Windfall Island
* **Missable:** No

Dampe's mother is found on the docks down the steps from the Juice Shop. You can easily take her photo from your boat.

locations.title: Miss Marie
locations.description:
* **Set:** Hall F: Windfall Island
* **Missable:** No

Miss Marie is the pink-haired teacher, inside the school at all times.

locations.title: Pompie & Vera
locations.description:
* **Set:** Hall F: Windfall Island
* **Missable:** No

Treated as a pair, Pompie & Vera are the two gossiping ladies near Zunari's shop. Double figurine.

The two also provide [Treasure Chart 24](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-wind-waker/maps/great-sea?locationIds=447347)

locations.title: Sam
locations.description:
* **Set:** Hall F: Windfall Island
* **Missable:** No

Sam is the guy with sideburns and brown vest, on the bench to the left of the cafe.

locations.title: Crab
locations.description:
* **Set:** Hall E: Outset Island
* **Missable:** No

The Crab Gallery Figurine can be unlocked by taking a full, head-on photo of the crustacean on the beach. The crab has to facing Link and be fully visible.

locations.title: Jabun
locations.description:
* **Set:** Hall E: Outset Island
* **Missable:** No

Fish spirit. Buy the Legendary Pictograph from Lenzo (Available when the moon is in its Last Quarter).

locations.title: Pig
locations.description:
* **Set:** Hall E: Outset Island
* **Missable:** No

Depending on when or where you visit, there are small or large pigs wandering around on Outset and Windfall Island. One photo is enough to get the quadruple-figurine of all pig types.

locations.title: Seagull
locations.description:
* **Set:** Hall E: Outset Island
* **Missable:** No

Sea bird. Found nearly everywhere.

locations.title: Gillian
locations.description:
* **Set:** Hall F: Windfall Island
* **Missable:** No

Cafe owner, behind the counter.

locations.title: Gossack
locations.description:
* **Set:** Hall F: Windfall Island
* **Missable:** No

Old man, easily startled. In the cafe during the day.

locations.title: Gummy
locations.description:
* **Set:** Hall F: Windfall Island
* **Missable:** No

Big sailor, wears a yellow shirt and black vest. Appears in the auction house at night. Snap picture after the auction ends.

locations.title: Big Octo
locations.description:
* **Set:** Hall D: Boss and Mini-Boss
* **Missable:** Yes

This sea monster is found near Seven-Star Isles, Tingle Island, Fire Mountain, Private Oasis, Diamond Steppe Island, Two-Eye Reef. Do not forget to take photos of it before you defeat them all!

locations.title: Blue Wizzrobe
locations.description:
* **Set:** Hall D: Boss and Mini-Boss
* **Missable:** No

Blue Wizzrobes are found in various locations, including platforms and submarines. A sure-fire encounter for purposes of picture taking can be triggered by going into the Savage Labyrinth.

locations.title: Darknut
locations.description:
* **Set:** Hall D: Boss and Mini-Boss
* **Missable:** No

Darknuts are armored knights found in various locations, such as dungeons and caves. A guaranteed encounter occurs in the Tower of the Gods.

locations.title: Darknut (2)
locations.description:
* **Set:** Hall D: Boss and Mini-Boss
* **Missable:** No

This second golden variant of the armored Darknut knight is easily found inside Hyrule Castle.

locations.title: Mighty Darknut
locations.description:
* **Set:** Hall D: Boss and Mini-Boss
* **Missable:** Yes

There are two chances to get a snapshot of this Darknut Captain in red armor: once in the battle in the castle basement, and again on the stairwell leading up to the fight with Ganon.

locations.title: Gohdan, the Great Arbiter
locations.description:
* **Set:** Hall D: Boss and Mini-Boss
* **Missable:** No

Statue head and hands, boss inside Tower of the Gods. You can snap a photo later when Gohdan has turned back into an immobile statue.

locations.title: Red Wizzrobe
locations.description:
* **Set:** Hall D: Boss and Mini-Boss
* **Missable:** Yes

This bird magician is clad in red and wears head gear. Catch it during the mini-boss battle in the Wind Temple.

locations.title: Moblin
locations.description:
* **Set:** Hall D: Bosses and Mini-Bosses
* **Missable:** No

Pig warrior, in various dungeons and caves, such as the Forsaken Fortress.

locations.title: Phantom Ganon
locations.description:
* **Set:** Hall D: Boss and Mini-Boss
* **Missable:** Yes

Shadow warrior, in the Forsaken Fortress courtyard (second visit) and Ganon's Tower.

locations.title: Stalfos
locations.description:
* **Set:** Hall C: Enemies
* **Missable:** No

Skeleton warrior, inside dungeons and caves, such as the Earth Temple.

locations.title: Bokoblin
locations.description:
* **Set:** Hall C: Enemies
* **Missable:** No

Link meets his first Bokoblin on Outset Island., but this green, blue, or pink goblin creature is commonly found in dungeons, caves, and on rafts and lookout platforms. One photo is enough for the triple-figurine.

locations.title: Floor Master
locations.description:
* **Set:** Hall C: Enemies
* **Missable:** No

Floor Master are creepy hands that are found in various caves and dungeons, including the Earth Temple.

locations.title: Keese & Fire Keese
locations.description:
* **Set:** Hall C: Enemies
* **Missable:** No

These bats are common and found everywhere -- a single picture of one type gets you the double set.

locations.title: Magtail
locations.description:
* **Set:** Hall C: Enemies
* **Missable:** No

Found in hot areas such as Dragon Roost Cavern and the Savage Labyrinth, you'll easily spot Magtails on Fire Mountain.

locations.title: Red Bubble & Blue Bubble
locations.description:
* **Set:** Hall C: Enemies
* **Missable:** No

These floating skulls come in two varieties. Take a picture of either one.

locations.title: Rat
locations.description:
* **Set:** Hall C: Enemies
* **Missable:** No

Commonly found inside ships and basements, Rats are easily photographed in the Forsaken Fortress.

locations.title: Boko Baba
locations.description:
* **Set:** Hall C: Enemies
* **Missable:** No

Easily spot the people-eating plants inside Forest Haven and the Forbidden Woods. Also found in various caves, from the Savage Labyrinth to the Cliff Plateau Isles.

locations.title: Miniblin
locations.description:
* **Set:** Hall C: Enemies
* **Missable:** No

Miniblins are common on smaller islands and inside dungeons.

locations.title: ChuChu
locations.description:
* **Set:** Hall C: Enemies
* **Missable:** No

ChuChus are common across many islands. Take a picture of any color to complete the gallery figure.

locations.title: Peahat
locations.description:
* **Set:** Hall C: Enemies
* **Missable:** No

You'll spot Peahats in the Forbidden Woods, Forest Haven, Outset Island the Wind Temple, and more.

locations.title: Gyorg
locations.description:
* **Set:** Hall C: Enemies
* **Missable:** No

Gyorg are common shark-like enemies found everywhere in the ocean. Spot their fin in the water and snap a picture even if the entire creature isn't exposed.

locations.title: Octorok
locations.description:
* **Set:** Hall C: Enemies
* **Missable:** No

Octoroks are found in the sea and rivers around Forest Haven, Forbidden Woods, Six-Eyed Reef, Shark Island, Boating Course, Forsaken Fortress, the Triangle Islands, and more.

locations.title: Seahat
locations.description:
* **Set:** Hall C: Enemies
* **Missable:** No

Common ocean enemy, found around islands in large groups. Horsehoe Island has a large number of them.

locations.title: Kargaroc
locations.description:
* **Set:** Hall C: Enemies
* **Missable:** No

These birds, also known as Kargarok (with a k) in other Zelda games, can be spotted around many rocky islands, including Dragon Roost Island.

locations.title: Armos
locations.description:
* **Set:** Hall C: Enemies
* **Missable:** No

These living statues are common inside the Tower of the Goods, as well as on Stone Watcher Island, in the Wind Temple, and the Savage Labyrinth.

locations.title: Armos Knight
locations.description:
* **Set:** Hall C: Enemies
* **Missable:** No

The upgraded version of the Armos is found in the Tower of the Goods, the Wind Temple, and the Savage Labyrinth.

locations.title: Morth
locations.description:
* **Set:** Hall C: Enemies
* **Missable:** No

Easily found inside the Forbidden Woods, Morth are spawned by Mothulas and Yellow Wizrobes, and appear in grass and barrels.

locations.title: Poe
locations.description:
* **Set:** Hall C: Enemies
* **Missable:** No

Poe are lantern-carrying ghosts you can photograph in the Earth Temple, the Ghost Ship, Ganon's Castle, and in the Savage Labyrinth.

locations.title: ReDead
locations.description:
* **Set:** Hall C: Enemies
* **Missable:** No

The screaming undead are found in the Earth Temple, Private Oasis, Ganon's Castle, and the Savage Labyrinth.

locations.title: Baito
locations.description:
* **Set:** Hall B: Dragon Roost Island
* **Missable:** No

Human part-time employee. Arrives on Dragon Roost Island after you score 25 letters in the sorting mini-game or after defeating the boss.

locations.title: Basht & Bisht
locations.description:
* **Set:** Hall B: Dragon Roost Island
* **Missable:** Mo

These two honest and sincere Rito guards are found inside the main hall guarding exits with their spears.

locations.title: The Rito Chieftain
locations.description:
* **Set:** Hall C: Dragon Roost Cavern
* **Missable:** No

The leader of the Rito, the Rito Chieftain, can be found inside his chambers. He wears a red robe.

locations.title: Hoskit
locations.description:
* **Set:** Hall C: Dragon Roost Cavern
* **Missable:** No

Hoskit the Rito waits outside the Chieftain's room and asks you for Golden Feathers. He'll reward Link with an Orange Rupee and a Piece of Heart for 20 of them.

locations.title: Ilari
locations.description:
* **Set:** Hall C: Dragon Roost Cavern
* **Missable:** No

The Rito postman can be seen on top of the outdoor platform. Take the picture before going to the Earth Temple. He is later seen on Outset Island.

locations.title: Koboli
locations.description:
* **Set:** Hall C: Dragon Roost Island
* **Missable:** No

This tall Rito stands behind the mail counter inside Dragon Roost Mountain.

locations.title: Namali
locations.description:
* **Set:** Hall C: Dragon Roost Cavern 
* **Missable:** No

Rito bookkeeper, walks around the mail station with a clipboard.

locations.title: Medli
locations.description:
* **Set:** Hall C: Dragon Roost Cavern
* **Missable:** No

Young Rito girl and one of the two sages. Encountered on Dragon Roost Island, she will stay in the boss room of the Earth Temple after the boss battle.

locations.title: Pashli
locations.description:
* **Set:** Hall C: Dragon Roost Cavern
* **Missable:** No

Pashli is the second Rito carrying a clipboard -- unlike Namali, he hurries about and his feather-doo is spiked up.

locations.title: Obli
locations.description:
* **Set:** Hall C: Dragon Roost Island
* **Missable:** No

Goggle-wearing Rito, complete with Orville Wright mustache. On the Flight Control Platform. Take the picture right before you take the challenge.

locations.title: Komali
locations.description:
* **Set:** Hall C: Dragon Roost Cavern
* **Missable:** No

Prince Komali is first encountered inside his room. After finishing the Earth Temple, he's on this cliff location here.

locations.title: Quill
locations.description:
* **Set:** Hall C: Dragon Roost Island
* **Missable:** No

Mailman you first met on Outset. Bundled with Chieftain figurine.

locations.title: Skett & Akoot
locations.description:
* **Set:** Hall C: Dragon Roost Island
* **Missable:** No

The Chieftain's guards guarding the exit from this room. Two-in one statue.

locations.title: Valoo
locations.description:
* **Set:** Hall C: Dragon Roost Island
* **Missable:** No

Valoo is the giant dragon on top of Dragon Roost Mountain. You only need a headshot -- can be taken from far away.

locations.title: Willi
locations.description:
* **Set:** Hall C: Dragon Roost Island
* **Missable:** No

The Wilbur to Obli's Orville. On the Flight Control Platform, standing in front of the ladder.

locations.title: Zephos & Cyclos
locations.description:
* **Set:** Hall C: Dragon Roost Island
* **Missable:** Yes

Wind gods. Take a picture of Cyclos when you get caught in his tornado, eg: near Shark Island. If you shoot him with an arrow before you've taken the photo, you're out of luck and have to wait till the second quest.

locations.title: Laruto
locations.description:
* **Set:** Hall C: Dragon Roost Island
* **Missable:** No

Zora. Buy the Legendary Pictograph from Lenzo (First Quarter).

locations.title: The Monstrous Helmaroc King
locations.description:
* **Set:** Hall D: Bosses and Mini-Bosses
* **Missable:** Yes

The Helmaroc King is first seen on Outset Island, but can't be photographed there. The only chance to capture a picture is when returning to the Forsaken Fortress, during the boss battle.

locations.title: Makar
locations.description:
* **Set:** Hall A: Forest Haven
* **Missable:** No

The Korok playing the violin also acts as sage and is first encountered behind the waterfall on Forest Haven. He will stay in the Wind Temple's boss room after you finish it.

locations.title: Deku Tree
locations.description:
* **Set:** Hall A: Forest Haven
* **Missable:** No

The Great Deku Tree is found at the center of Forest Haven.

locations.title: Fado
locations.description:
* **Set:** Hall A: Forest Haven
* **Missable:** No

Young Kokiri. Buy the Legendary Pictograph from Lenzo (Waxing Crescent).

locations.title: Olivio
locations.description:
* **Set:** Hall A: Forest Haven
* **Missable:** No

The Korok with the red leaf permanently settles on Eastern Fairy Island and can be found as part of the Withered Tree quest.

locations.title: Hollo
locations.description:
* **Set:** Hall A: Forest Haven
* **Missable:** No

Hollo is the Korok potion master, found on the ground floor of Forest Haven, through the exit with the sign next to it.

locations.title: Elma
locations.description:
* **Set:** Hall A: Forest Haven
* **Missable:** No

Korok with round leaf. First seen inside Forest Haven, later settles on Needle Rock Island.

locations.title: Drona
locations.description:
* **Set:** Hall A: Forest Haven
* **Missable:** No

The green Korok with the forked leaf is first spotted inside Forest Haven, but later permanently settles on the Private Oasis.

locations.title: Rown
locations.description:
* **Set:** Hall A: Forest Haven
* **Missable:** No

First seen in Forest Haven, this brown Korok with the five-fingered leaf later settles on the Mother & Child Isles.

locations.title: Irch
locations.description:
* **Set:** Hall A: Forest Haven
* **Missable:** No

This brown Korok with large oval birch leaf is first spotted in Forest Haven before permanently settling on Shark Island.

locations.title: Oakin
locations.description:
* **Set:** Hall A: Forest Haven
* **Missable:** No

This tall Korok is first spotted in Forest Haven, before settling on Star Island.

locations.title: Aldo
locations.description:
* **Set:** Hall A: Forest Haven
* **Missable:** No

Green Korok with heart-shaped alder leaf is spotted inside Forest Haven before moving to the Cliff Plateau Isles. To reach him, you'll have to head through the cave.

locations.title: Linder
locations.description:
* **Set:** Hall A: Forest Haven
* **Missable:** No

Green Korok with butterfly-shaped leaf, settles on Greatfish Isle.

locations.title: Carlov the Sculptor
locations.description:
* **Set:** Hall A: Forest Haven
* **Missable:** No

The owner of the figurine gallery. Behind the counter.

locations.title: Manny
locations.description:
* **Set:** Hall A: Forest Haven
* **Missable:** No

Inside the gallery. Either standing near counter or looking at figurines in the rooms.

locations.title: Kogoli
locations.description:
* **Set:** Hall B: Dragon Roost Island
* **Missable:** No

Rito delivery man, outside on the launch platform. Take the picture before going to the Earth Temple.

locations.title: Mothula
locations.description:
* **Set:** Hall D: Bosses
* **Missable:** No

Spot the flying creature for the first time as a mini-boss inside the Forbidden Woods. You can also find Mothulas on Dragon Roost Island, Horsehoe Island, Outset Island's Savage Labyrinth.

locations.title: Ganondorf
locations.description:
* **Set:** Hall D: Bosses
* **Missable:** No

Buy the Legendary Pictograph from Lenzo (Full Moon)

locations.title: Jalhalla, Protector of the Seal
locations.description:
* **Set:** Hall D: Bosses
* **Missable:** No

Lantern ghost, boss inside Earth Temple and Ganon's Tower.

locations.title: Puppet Ganon
locations.description:
* **Set:** Hall D: Bosses
* **Missable:** Yes

You only have one chance to take a picture of this marionette boss inside Ganon's Tower.

locations.title: Molgera, Protector of the Seal
locations.description:
* **Set:** Hall D: Bosses
* **Missable:** No

Sand shark, boss inside Wind Temple and Ganon's Tower.

locations.title: Kalle Demos
locations.description:
* **Set:** Hall D: Bosses
* **Missable:** No

Plant monster, boss inside Forbidden Woods and Ganon's Tower.

locations.title: Gohma
locations.description:
* **Set:** Hall D: Bosses
* **Missable:** No

Gohma is an arachnid boss who lives in a lava lake. To make it vulnerable to your sword attacks, use your Grappling Hook to connect to the hook under the ceiling, above its head.  and Ganon's Tower.

You can take its picture during the Dragon Roost Cavern Boss Batlte or in Ganon's Twoer.

locations.title: Song of Passing
locations.description:
**Directions:** Right, Left, Down

**Effect:** Turn day to night and night to day.

Learn the Song of Passing from Tott by taking out the Wind Waker.

locations.title: Ballad of Gales
locations.description:
**Directions:** Down, Right, Left, Up

**Effect:** Warp around the map.

Head for the tornado and get sucked in -- then use your bow to shoot Cyclos three times to receive the Ballad of Gales song.

Play the Ballad of Gales to warp between map locations.

locations.title: Wind God's Aria
locations.description:
**Directions:** Up, Up, Down, Right, Left, Right

**Effect:** Play in a duo with Makar to open stone seals

Put on your Iron Boots to get past the strong wind and approach the cave entrance. Equip your hammer and smash the giant stone head that generates the wind. Enter the cave and walk up to the stone seal. Examine it with A, then take out your Wind Waker and play the melody: up, up, down, right, left, right.

locations.title: Wind's Requiem
locations.description:
**Directions:** Up, Left, Right

**Effect:** Change the direction of the wind.

Get out the Wind Waker and play the melody you see engraved on the stone tablet: Up, Left, Right. You will meet Zephos and learn the Wind's Requiem.

locations.title: Command Melody
locations.description:
**Directions:** Left, Center, Right, Center

**Effect:** Control a friendly character or idol to solve puzzles

Find the door with the magenta Triforce symbol. If you bring an idol into this room, the stone tablet revealing the song will appear.

locations.title: Earth God's Lyric
locations.description:
**Directions:** Down, Down, Center, Right, Left, Center 

**Effect:** Play in a duo with Medli to open stone seals

Lift up that giant stone head with the help of the Power Bracelets and smash it on the ground. Enter the cave.

locations.title: Beedle's Chart
locations.description:
* **Location:** Get by Mail
* **Use:** Marks the locations of Beedle's Shop Ships

To get Beedle's Chart, progress through the story and get the Bombs in Windfall Island. As soon as you've got the Bombs, Beedle will send you a letter in the mail with this chart attached.

locations.title: Ghost Ship Chart
locations.description:
**Location:** Inside the cave
* **Use:** Tells you the location of the [Ghost Ship](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-wind-waker/maps/great-sea?locationIds=449303), based on the phase of the moon

Once you get the Hookshot, enter the cave on top of this ship-shaped rock and follow the map instructions above.

locations.title: Great Fairy Chart (via Chart 41)
locations.description:

**Contents:** Great Fairy Chart

_The Great Fairy Chart marks the locations of all the Fairy Fountains._

locations.title: In-Credible Chart
locations.description:
* **Location:** Any Mailbox
* **Use:** The IN-Credible Chart lists all the Triforce Chart locations, and, once you've had a Triforce Chart deciphered by Tingle, also the corresponding Triforce location.

Rescue your sister from the Forsaken Fortress. After those events, find any Mailbox to get this key chart from Tingle. It costs 201 Rupees.

locations.title: Triforce Chart 1 (GameCube + HD)
locations.description: Sail to the small iron fortress and blow up the ship guarding its entrance.  Stand on the wind symbol and play the Wind's Requiem to make a treasure chest appear. Inside, you will find Triforce Chart 1, which leads to [Triforce Shard 1](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-wind-waker/maps/great-sea?locationIds=447312).

locations.title: Triforce Chart 2 (GameCube)
locations.description: Get the [Cabana Deed](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-wind-waker/maps/great-sea?locationIds=455608) on Windfall Island to enter the Private Oasis. Use the Grappling Hook inside and crawl through the fireplace. Hit the switches in the labyrinth. Stand on the wind tile and play the Wind's Requiem to summon the Treasure Chest containing the chart. Follow the marked location to get Triforce Shard 2.

locations.title: Triforce Chart 2 (HD)
locations.description:
The chart  leads to [Triforce Shard 3](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-wind-waker/maps/great-sea?locationIds=447315) near Stone Watcher Island. Bring some Hyoi Pears along as you need to trigger the Crystal Switches on the rock spires to open the door to the treasure chamber.

Note: The location for Triforce Chart 2 on GameCube is different.

locations.title: Triforce Chart 3 (GameCube)
locations.description: Use a Hyoi Pear to fly a seagull into the nearby switches on top of the rock spires. This opens the door to the treasure chest, which contains Triforce Chart 3 (GameCube). Follow the chart to [Triforce Shard 3](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-wind-waker/maps/great-sea?locationIds=447315).

locations.title: Triforce Chart 3 (HD)
locations.description:
**Location:** Sink the Golden Gunboat, then raise the chest containing the chart. Exact location depends on boat location. Follow the chart to [Triforce Shard 5](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-wind-waker/maps/great-sea?locationIds=447318).

**Contents:** Triforce Chart 3 (Wii U/HD version only -- in the GameCube version, it is replaced with [Triforce Chart 5 (GameCube)](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-wind-waker/maps/great-sea?locationIds=447241))

locations.title: Triforce Chart 4 (GameCube)
locations.description:
**Location:** Inside the Ghost Ship

Ghost Ship location depends on the phase of the moon. Retrieve the Chart to find the location of [Triforce Shard #4 (GameCube)](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-wind-waker/maps/great-sea?locationIds=447317).

locations.title: Triforce Chart 5 (GameCube)
locations.description:
Sink the Golden Gunboat, then raise the chest containing the chart. Exact location depends on boat location. Follow the chart to [Triforce Shard 5](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-wind-waker/maps/great-sea?locationIds=447318).

 Triforce Chart 5 is available only in the GameCube version -- in the Wii U/HD version, it is replaced with [Triforce Chart 3](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-wind-waker/maps/great-sea?locationIds=447239))

locations.title: Triforce Chart 7 (GameCube)
locations.description: Life the stone head with the Power Bracelets and enter the cave. Defeat all enemies to get to the treasure chamber. Inside, play the Wind's Requiem while standing on the blue emblem to make the treasure chest appear.  Follow the chart to [Triforce Shard 7 (GameCube)](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-wind-waker/maps/great-sea?locationIds=447321).

locations.title: Triforce Chart 8 (GameCube)
locations.description: Hookshot to the cave, then clear all the rooms by defeating the monsters. Once the dungeon is free of enemies, the door with the Triforce symbol above it will open. Enter and stand on top of the Wind Crest. Play the Wind's Requiem to make the treasure chest appear. Follow the chart to [Triforce Shard 8 (GameCube)](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-wind-waker/maps/great-sea?locationIds=447323).

locations.title: Triforce Shard 1 (GameCube + HD)

locations.description: Seahats are water-based cousins of the much smaller, flying Peahats. Seahats are easily spotted because of their size -- that is, if the helicopter sound hasn't given them away by then. The flying fish will attack by ramming the boat, knocking Link into the water. Hit it with your arrows -- or better, the Boomerang -- and it will lose its rotor. Hit it again to defeat it and always reveal an item orb. You can also use a single cannon shot to blow it to tomorrow.

Seahats are easily spotted because of their size -- that is, if the helicopter sound hasn't given them away by then. The flying fish will attack by ramming the boat, knocking Link into the water. Hit it with your arrows -- or better, the Boomerang -- and it will lose its rotor. Hit it again to defeat it and always reveal an item orb. You can also use a single cannon shot to blow it to tomorrow.
